direction.description: which way custody crosses the firm boundary — a field, not a module

description.description: what it is ('3 pallets from Sysco', 'package for Dana'). free-form, and the mailroom case writes a person into it ('package for Dana'). Untemplated, so it takes the closed default

contents.description: informational lines [{item_id?, description, qty}] — the counted truth goes through manage_po receive. informational lines carrying free-form text. The COUNTED truth is not here — it is the inventory movement `manage_po receive` writes, which publishes

carrier.description: carrier slug: fedex | ups | usps | dhl | ontrac | freight | courier | other (open string). upgrades to carrier_gerp_id when carriers run gerps

tracking.description: carrier tracking id, VERBATIM — provider ids are never platform-prefixed. a carrier tracking id is a live query into the carrier's system, which returns the destination address and who signed. Freight economics publish without it

service.description: carrier service label as given (ground, 2day, priority, ltl)

tracking_url.description: generated from a per-carrier template for known carriers; a convenience string, lambda-managed. carries the tracking id

sender.description: contact_id of who sent it (inbound provenance)

recipient.description: contact_id the parcel is FOR — the mailroom case; arrival notifies, pickup closes

destination.description: the polymorphic key: stock (dock → manage_po receive pairs), person (mailroom), customer (fulfillment). inferred from recipient/po_id/invoice_id when omitted

po_id.description: the PO an inbound delivery fulfills; custody here, money+quantity legs on manage_po receive

invoice_id.description: the invoice/order an outbound shipment fulfills

status.description: inbound: expected→arrived→putaway|delivered|picked_up; outbound: packed→shipped→delivered; exception/cancelled from any open state

expected.description: ISO date an inbound shipment is expected

signed_by.description: who signed/confirmed at receive or pickup — the chain-of-custody stamp

condition.description: condition on arrival; damage/short detail becomes a task with subject_key = the shipment id. about the parcel, not the party

cost.description: freight cost; posts Dr SHIPPING_EXPENSE at ship (outbound) / receive (inbound), once, with freight_entry as the receipt

freight_entry.description: the freight journal entry id; lambda-managed, posted at most once per shipment

open_flag.description: lambda-managed sparse-GSI marker: present until a terminal status. Not user-settable

job.description: optional job tag; the freight entry carries dimensions.job for per-job cost
